descriptions.signIn: Sign in to your School of Gaming account to see your gamers’ upcoming sessions, manage enrolments and keep your family’s details up to date.
descriptions.createAccount: Create your family’s School of Gaming account and enrol your child in clubs, camps and events led by professional Game Educators.
descriptions.forgotPassword: Forgotten your password? Give us your email address and we will send you a link to choose a new one for your School of Gaming account.
descriptions.resetPassword: Choose a new password for your School of Gaming account from the link we emailed you, then sign in with it straight away.
descriptions.registerGedu: Apply to become a Game Educator with School of Gaming and lead clubs, camps and events for children in the games they already play.
descriptions.about: Who School of Gaming is, what Yty is, and answers to the questions families ask before they enrol their child.
descriptions.library: Practical guidance from School of Gaming for parents on online safety, screen time and family life, and what children learn through games.
descriptions.shop: Browse School of Gaming’s clubs, camps and events in Minecraft, Roblox, Fortnite and more, and find one that fits your child’s week.
descriptions.resetPin: Set a new parent PIN for your School of Gaming account from the link we emailed you. The PIN is what keeps the parent-only pages closed to your child.
descriptions.privacy: How School of Gaming collects, uses and stores your family’s data: what we hold about a child, who we share it with, and the rights you can exercise.
descriptions.terms: The terms you agree to when you use School of Gaming: how enrolments, payments and cancellations work, and what we and you are each responsible for.
descriptions.antiBullying: How School of Gaming prevents bullying in its clubs, camps and events, what happens when it occurs, and the discipline steps a Game Educator follows.
descriptions.attributions: The sources and licences behind the data School of Gaming uses: place names, postcodes and player heads, each credited the way its licence requires.
descriptions.team: Meet the people behind School of Gaming: the team who run it and the Game Educators who lead its clubs, camps and events, each introduced in their own words.
